QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Officer of the Day
QuestInfo.0: Yoria is running a Lunar New Year Video Message Project. She's helping deliver messages between officers and their families while they aid in Maple World's restoration! But who will be Officer of the Day?
QuestInfo.1:
Today's lucky Officer of the Day is Angelic Buster!
You'll find Angelic Buster #bunder the Lunar New Year tree#k. Tell her all about the Lunar New Year Video Message Project!
QuestInfo.2: Angelic Buster excitedly agreed to record a message as if she's been waiting for just this. Talk to her to record the video message!

default.0: Angelic Buster is #bunder the Lunar New Year tree#k.
